simple.summary: קָשָׂה (qâsâh) means a jug (from its shape) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 28 17.

definitions.full: H7184. qasah or qasvah [ קַשְׂוָה , Kö ii. 1, 165 ] noun feminine a kind of jug, jar , utensil of tabernacle and (Chronicles) temple; — plural קְשָׂוֺת Exod 37:16 ; 1Chr 28:19 ; construct הַנָּ֑סֶח קְשׂוֺת Num 4:7 jars of the drink-offering ; suffix (of table) Exod 25:29 .
definitions.rootNote: or קַשְׂוָה ; from an unused root meaning to be round ;
